purpose: Validate that a property evidence fixture impact event has propagated correctly before the affected pathway can return to its previous validation state.

checks.name: Impact event identity
checks.requirement: Event ID and fixture ID must match the dependency registry.

checks.name: Version transition
checks.requirement: Previous and new fixture versions must be recorded for material changes.

checks.name: Dependency completeness
checks.requirement: All required dependent tests, runs, pathways and propositions must be identified.

checks.name: Historical immutability
checks.requirement: Previous validation results must remain unchanged.

checks.name: Revalidation
checks.requirement: A material fixture change must produce a new validation run before the dependency can be considered revalidated.

checks.name: Provenance review
checks.requirement: Source-derived fixtures with provenance changes require provenance review.

checks.name: Privacy review
checks.requirement: A privacy-impacting fixture change remains blocked until privacy review passes.

checks.name: Publication separation
checks.requirement: Fixture validation must not automatically make a pathway publication-ready.

guardrails: Passing this contract validates impact propagation, not the correctness of Irish property law.
Fixture validation cannot create live property evidence.
Historical validation runs cannot be edited to reflect later fixture changes.
Publication remains governed by the separate legal-source and evidence gates.
